topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: ABC Insurance Ltd. wants to insulate the shareholder's funds from unpredictable losses. Devise a solution.
e: Correct answer: Reinsurance contract (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Financial statements prepared on which basis comply with the provisions of the The Insurance Amendment Act 2015 and the Companies Act 2013?
o: Market cost convention and accrual basis
Market cost convention and actual basis
Historic cost convention and actual basis
Historic cost convention and accrual basis
Book Value convention and accrual basis
e: Correct answer: Historic cost convention and accrual basis (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: CSAV Limited is a marine insurance Company. As per the AS - 11, the depreciation on fixed assets held by the company in foreign branches and agencies is provided on which value?
o: Market value at the year end
Written down rupee value at the year end
e: Correct answer: Written down rupee value at the year end (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Schedule II of the IRDAI (Investment) Regulation provides A list of Approved Investments for general insurance business. Which of the following are approved investment?

I. Commercial Papers issued by a company having a credit rating
II. Immovable property situated in another country
III. First mortgage on immovable property situated in another country
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Device a term to describe the period over which a depreciable asset is expected to be used by the enterprise.
e: Correct answer: Useful Life (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Single set of accounting policies are strictly followed by all enterprises in all circumstances. Debate. Choose the most appropriate option.
o: All enterprises follow different types of accounting policies based on their nature and structure
All enterprises are required to follow the same se
e: Correct answer: All enterprises follow different types of accounting policies based on their nature and structure (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: If unearned premium exceeds such reserve for unexpired risks calculated as Section 64V(1)(ii) of The Insurance Act, 1938, the difference is to be accounted for as __________.
e: Correct answer: Unearned premium (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: A ltd has a equity share capital of 5,000 equity shares of Rs. 10 each. It has decided to issue 5 shares for every 10 shares held without any consideration.  The shares such issued shall be referred to as?
e: Correct answer: Bonus Shares (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Shubha Mudgal Pvt. Ltd forfeits 200 shares of Rs.10 each on which Rs.800 had been received. The company reissues these shares for Rs.1200 as fully paid.  What is the amount to be transferred to the capital reserve account?
e: Correct answer: NIL (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which one of these is not one of the causes for difference in balance as per pass book and as per cash book?
o: Cheques issued but not presented for payment
e: Correct answer: Cheques deposited and cleared (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Identify the principle which requires that the financial statements be prepared in the same manner, period after period.
e: Correct answer: Principle of Consistency (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: A company cannot issue the same kind of shares or securities for a period of __________ after completion of buy-back
e: Correct answer: 24 months (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which Schedule of the IRDAI (Investment) Regulation provides the list of approved investments for general insurance business for the purpose of sec 27B of the Act?
e: Correct answer: Schedule II (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following statements is/are true about Journal?

I. Journalisation is the process of converting transactions and events into a debit-credit format
II. Transactions are recorded in a chronological order
III. In a journal credits are recorded on the left side and debits on the right side
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: ABC Ltd has bought a machine which shall become obsolete after a few years. Suggest a tool that shall help ABC Ltd to make funds available at the end of the life of a asset to buy a new one and also account for the actual value of the asset in the books of accounts.
e: Correct answer: Depreciation (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: ABC Ltd. a general insurance company is planning to invest funds received from policy holders and share holders in bonds of Housing & Development Corporation Limited and National Housing Bank. What is the minimum investment limit of such investment?
e: Correct answer: 5% (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: This concept states that the revenue and the expenses incurred to earn the revenue must belong to the same accounting period.  Identify the concept.
e: Correct answer: Matching concept (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: As per Regulation 13 A of IRDAI (Investment) (Fifth Amendment) Regulations 2013, every Insurer shall draw up, annually an investment policy and place the same before  the ________.
e: Correct answer: Board of Directors (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: __________ is useful in providing users of financial statements with a basis to assess the ability of the firm to generate cash and cash equivalent, and the needs of the firm to utilise those cash flows.
e: Correct answer: Cash Flow Statement (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Identify the correct journal entry to be passed at the time of receiving share application money.
o: Bank A/c . Dr. To, Share  Application A/c  Cr.
Share  Application A/c  . Dr. To,  Bank A/c  Cr.
Share  Application A/c  . Dr. To,  Share Capital
Bank A/c . Dr. To, Share  Allotment A/c  Cr.
Bank A/c . Dr. To, Share  Capital A/c  Cr.
e: Correct answer: Bank A/c . Dr. To, Share  Application A/c  Cr. (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
While auditing claim expenses, the auditor checks whether the accounting estimate includes claims cost adjusted for estimated salvage value if there is sufficient degree of certainty of its realization. What is the purpose of this procedure?

I. To verify classification and accounting under appropriate headings in the FS
II. To verify completeness of liability account
III. To verify accuracy of expenses
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: If, during an accounting period, an expense item has been incurred and consumed but not yet paid for or recorded, then the end-of-period adjusting entry would involve:-
o: A receivable account and a revenue account.
A liability account and an expense account
An asset or contra asset account and an expense ac
A liability account and an asset account
A liability account and an capital account
e: Correct answer: A liability account and an expense account (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following statement/s is / are true about the imprest system of petty cash?

I. Each month an equal amount of cash is transferred into petty cash
II. The exact amount of petty cash expenditure is reimbursed at intervals to maintain a fixed float
III. Amount of petty cash should not exceed Rs. 10,000
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which of the following ratios is an important indicator that helps to judge whether an insurer is earning profit on its Net premium amount?
o: Gross Direct Premium to shareholders' fund ratio
e: Correct answer: Net earnings ratio (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: ABC ltd. Is one of the leading insurance company with a large shareholder base. The price of the shares of the company on a stock exchange is very high which makes its shares less liquid and is not within reach of the prospective buyers. It wants to reduce the price of the shares without a stock spilt. What should the company do?
e: Correct answer: Bonus issue (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: The bank balance according to the cash book of Flower Ltd is Rs.5,000 (debit), while the bank statement shows a credit balance of Rs.5,400. Considering that there was no error in the cash book or the bank statement, which of the following is the reason for this difference?
o: Bank interest of Rs.400 credited by the bank
Cheque of Rs.400 issued but not presented for payment
Dividend income of Rs.400 directly collected and c
Bank charges of Rs.400 debited by the bank
Standing charges of Rs.400 not recorded in cash bo
e: Correct answer: Cheque of Rs.400 issued but not presented for payment (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following are out of the scope of AS 9 Revenue Recognition?

I. Revenue arising from construction contracts
II. Revenue of hire purchase agreements
III. Revenue of insurance companies
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
The profit of a trader would change as a result of:

I. A creditor being paid through cheque
II. Raw materials being purchased on credit
III. Fixed assets being purchased on credit
IV. Wages being paid in cash
e: Correct answer: Only IV (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
While auditing Management expenses, the auditor checks whether the items of management expenses in excess of one percent of net premium or Rs. 5,00,000 (or any other amount as per corporate policy) whichever is higher have been shown separately. What is the purpose of this procedure?

I. To verify classification and accounting under appropriate headings in the FS
II. To verify completeness of liability account
III. To verify accuracy of expenses
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Device a term to describe the amount realised on disposal of the asset at the end of its useful life.

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment

o: Higher of cost and fair value
Lower of cost and fair value
e: Correct answer: Cost (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: In accordance with IRDAI regulations, Cash Flow statement in an insurance company is to be prepared using the ______________.
e: Correct answer: Direct method (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment

e: Correct answer: Facultative Reinsurance (from the IC46 question bank).

The correct option is "Cost of sales - Rs.120,000 Cost of inventory - Rs.370,000"

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following statement/s is/are correct?

I. The business entity concept does not apply to sole proprietorship
II. If economic event cannot be measured in monetary terms, it is not considered as a part of accounting data
III. The matching principle is based on accrual concept of accounting
e: Correct answer: II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
As per SEBI Guidelines, which of the conditions should be satisfied in order to make a bonus issue?

I. No issue within 12 months of public issue
II. Bonus issue can be out of capital redemption reserves
III. Bonus issue can be made in lieu of dividend
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Inventories shall be measured at:
o: Lower of cost or net realisable value
Lower of cost or market value
e: Correct answer: Lower of cost or net realisable value (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: ABC Ltd. is a company having huge reserves and desires to capitalise its by increasing its equity base. Suggest a solution for a company.
e: Correct answer: Bonus issue (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment

e: Correct answer: Accounting cost concept (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Tax liability in foreign countries is accounted for on ___________.

II. Accrual Basis
III. Calculation basis
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment

Have a full time Company Secretary
Have a quarterly audit done by a qualified Charter
Should have a risk management department

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Calculate the percentage of completion from the following details of a construction contract: Total contract price - Rs 100 lakhs Work certified - Rs.35 lakhs Work not certified - Rs. 10 lakhs Estimated further cost of completion - Rs. 45 lakhs
e: Correct answer: 50% (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment

II. Distribution of profits

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment

e: Correct answer: Rs.2975 (from the IC46 question bank).
